entities.summary: Irina Alfredovna Gecht is a Russian politician serving as Governor of Nenets Autonomous Okrug since September 2025. A member of the United Russia political party, she has served as First Deputy Governor of Chelyabinsk Oblast from 2019 to 2024 and previously as Russian Federation Senator from Chelyabinsk Oblast from 2014 to 2019.
